thread:
harper: quick heads-up : our recent change to package exports removed the package root and switched some targets to nested-only. A couple of onboarding samples started throwing in edge/CDN and in downstream repos using pnpm hoisting.
nina: what failures are we seeing exactly?
harper: two main failure modes: (1) runtime: Edge (Vercel/Cloudflare) builds error with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` / `Could not resolve package 'redwood-sdk'` when sample apps import the package root; (2) TS/IDE: language server warns there are no types for 'redwood-sdk' because the root types pointer is missing and our typesVersions mapping wasn't updated.
kevin: interesting twist: one sample app uses `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` and another uses `const {createClient} = require('redwood-sdk')`. Our exports map only provided `./client` and `./server` paths so bare imports break and earlier CJS consumers get a different shape. Some bundlers also tried to resolve `./index.js` and failed.
harper: exact shipped snippet (abbreviated):
```json
"exports": { "./client": "./dist/esm/client.js", "./server": "./dist/cjs/server.js" }
```
nina: ouch. That explains the stray errors. What's the proposed fix?
kevin: patch idea: restore a root entry with explicit conditions and types, add `./package.json` entry, and add `typesVersions` for TS to help older TS versions. Example we plan to publish:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" },
  "./*": "./dist/*",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
},
"types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
"typesVersions": { "*": { "*": ["dist/types/*"] } },
"main": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
"module": "./dist/esm/index.js"
```
harper: also seen panics in our retry middleware when the SDK shape changed (some code imported `default` and then accessed `.defaults.retry`); we should run integration smoke tests for auth+retry flows in the sample-app matrix.
ci-bot: recommended actions: publish canary -> run sample-apps matrix (node/bun/deno/edge) -> run integration smoke for auth/retry.
nina: add a small prepublish script `scripts/validate-exports.js` to assert `.` and `./package.json` exist and types file is present. Fail publish if missing.
kevin: agree. Also add a lint rule to sample-apps to prefer explicit public paths where appropriate, and update starter templates to use root import only if it's guaranteed stable.
harper: I'll open the packaging PR with the root export + types mapping and a short repro in examples/edge-repro that fails on prod and passes on canary. tagging @devex @eng-runtime.
ops-bot: ACTION: (1) harper -> open packaging PR; (2) nina -> add exports validator & typesVersions; (3) kevin -> add sample-apps CI auth/retry smoke tests and canary-run.
harper: thanks! I'll post PR link when ready. If anyone has other resolver quirks (e.g., pnpmhoist + workspace packages reading package.json directly), drop them here.
